claims: The Artemis II mission concluded with a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026, at approximately 5:07 p.m. PDT.
The Orion capsule landed about 40 to 50 miles off the coast of San Diego, California.
The crew was recovered by U.S. Navy personnel.
The landing location was the Pacific Ocean, southwest of San Diego, CA.
The recovery ship was U.S.S. John P. Murtha.
The Artemis II mission duration was 10 days.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The crew returned from a lunar flyby.
The crew and capsule were recovered for return to base
